DSCF5186.RAF.subject: white roadster under the Shinjuku billboard
DSCF5186.RAF.intent: the car is the hero: lift it; the empty tarmac in the bottom third sinks; billboard kept
DSCF5186.RAF.reading: Night in Shinjuku: a white roadster lit by the street, a giant billboard above it. Mixed light — warm street lamps, cool cyan screens. The car is the subject; the billboard is the brightest thing in the frame and must not burn. Mood: the warm buzz of a city night.

DSCF5194.RAF.subject: neon alley, crowd at the end of the street
DSCF5194.RAF.intent: signs glow; open the crowd only a little (a shadows lift there went foggy)
DSCF5194.RAF.reading: A narrow neon alley at night: a column of signs on the right, a crowd far down the street, a black sky. The signs ARE the light — their colours must stay. Mood: warm, busy, inviting.

DSCF5807.RAF.subject: sea nettle jellyfish, bell upper middle
DSCF5807.RAF.intent: the jellyfish glows against deep water
DSCF5807.RAF.reading: A sea nettle in an aquarium, lit from above against deep blue water (f/1.4, ISO 3200). The amber bell is the subject, the water is the mood: amber against teal, complementary.

_DSF6994.RAF.subject: man looking up into crystal lights (teamLab)
_DSF6994.RAF.intent: a touch of light on the face — exposure and texture only: a shadows lift there laid a veil over the face ('why the man's face cover in blur')
_DSF6994.RAF.reading: A man looking up into a room of crystal lights (teamLab). The light is the artist's — cool, sparkling, every colour placed. His face is the subject: its skin colour must stay true and the face sharp, no veil.

_DSF6999.RAF.subject: man in silhouette among glowing orbs (teamLab)
_DSF6999.RAF.intent: keep the silhouette; the faintest lift on the face
_DSF6999.RAF.reading: A man in near-silhouette among glowing orbs (teamLab). Pink, violet and green light from the art — the orbs are the picture. Nothing should change their colour; the face only needs to read.

_DSF7014.RAF.subject: two silhouettes in amber mist (teamLab)
_DSF7014.RAF.intent: keep the fire glow; sink the dead ceiling

DSCF5288.RAF.subject: temple roofs and sakura under a pale sky (Kamakura)
DSCF5288.RAF.intent: deepen the pale sky, lift the sakura, keep the roofs with detail — shadows+=6 on the mood's lifted toe went milky, contrast+=6 blacks-=4 crushed the roofs black; the mood at 0.8 with nothing else is the middle
DSCF5288.RAF.reading: Hase-dera temple in spring: layered dark wooden roofs with gold ornaments, sakura on the hill behind, a pale blue sky with soft cloud. Bright daylight. The roofs against the blossoms are the subject; the depth comes from the dark wood. Mood: calm spring.

DSCF5411.RAF.subject: five-storey pagoda against white sky (Asakusa)
DSCF5411.RAF.intent: the sky is 70% of the frame: grade it down from the top; lift the tower
DSCF5411.RAF.reading: The five-storey pagoda at Senso-ji under a white overcast sky that fills 70 % of the frame. Flat, soft light. The red-and-dark tower is the subject; the sky needs density so the tower stands out instead of floating in white.

_DSF5417.RAF.subject: Asakusa Nakamise shop with the drugstore sign
_DSF5417.RAF.reading: Asakusa Nakamise shopfront on an overcast day: the big red-and-yellow drugstore sign, white facade, a lantern, cherry blossom. A colourful street — the sign's red and the facade's white must stay true.

_DSF6151.RAF.subject: Nikko shrine under cedars
_DSF6151.RAF.intent: lift the shrine, tame the bright sky patches
_DSF6151.RAF.reading: Nikko Toshogu: tall cedars over a lacquered shrine, late sun breaking through the trees. The forest dominates; the red-and-gold shrine sits at the bottom. Mood: a deep, sacred forest — depth in the greens.

_DSF6332.RAF.subject: Mt Fuji over the river bridge, through a train window
_DSF6332.RAF.intent: cut the window haze in the sky, pull Fuji out
_DSF6332.RAF.reading: Mt Fuji over the river bridge, shot from a train through tinted glass — haze and a green cast over everything. A wide sky with clouds, a green field. Mood: wide, quiet, a little lonely.

_DSF6592.RAF.subject: two deer by a temple building (Nara)
_DSF6592.RAF.intent: lift the deer, settle the foreground gravel
_DSF6592.RAF.reading: Two deer before a temple building in Nara, under trees, soft shade light, gravel in front. The deer are the subject: their brown coat must stay natural; the dark building gives depth.

_DSF6609.RAF.subject: castle moat, stone wall and bridge (Nijo)
_DSF6609.RAF.intent: deepen the sky band, keep the green reflections
_DSF6609.RAF.reading: Nijo Castle moat on an overcast day: trees, the stone wall, a wooden bridge, dark green water mirroring the sky. Calm and still; the reflection gives the depth.

_DSF6613.RAF.subject: woman in a pink skirt before the palace (Nijo)
_DSF6613.RAF.intent: she is small: lift her; deepen the white sky
_DSF6613.RAF.reading: A woman in a pink skirt, small before the palace at Nijo; a white overcast sky, the dark wooden building, grass. She is the subject: her skin and the pink must stay true; the building gives weight and the sky needs density.

_DSF6686.RAF.subject: deer grazing under a tree (Nara)
_DSF6686.RAF.intent: lift the deer, tame the bright sky patches
_DSF6686.RAF.reading: A deer grazing on the lawn under a big tree in Nara Park, soft daylight. The deer is the subject in its natural colour; green grass and trees around it.

_DSF6696 (1).RAF.subject: sea wall under a forested mountain (Miyajima)
_DSF6696 (1).RAF.intent: grade the sky, settle the water, a touch more contrast for the flat light
_DSF6696 (1).RAF.reading: A sea wall under a forested mountain at Miyajima: flat overcast light, grey-green water, a pale sky. A low-contrast scene — it needs depth without turning dark.

_DSF6778.RAF.subject: Osaka castle framed by cherry branches
_DSF6778.RAF.intent: lift the castle and its green roof inside the frame of branches

_DSF6904.RAF.subject: stone lantern on a garden pond, reflections
_DSF6904.RAF.intent: lift the lantern, sink the bright building top-left
_DSF6904.RAF.reading: A stone lantern on a garden pond, trees lit by late sun, everything mirrored in still water. The reflection is half the picture; the greens should be deep.
